description: §38.10.2 clean neg — a `const` declared LATER in the file is not visible at the `<channel>` (reading it there is E-SCOPE-001), so an `onclient:*` binding of the same name hides nothing and E-CHANNEL-HANDLER-SHADOW does not fire. Contrast state cells and functions, which hoist and do collide.
rationale: §38.10.2: the binding name SHALL NOT name a declaration visible at the channel's position; a later `const` / `let` is not visible there.
